physicalVerification: 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-10 with the user observing devices; see write-experiment.json
hardwareWritesEnabledByDefault: only the verified settings below; everything else stays read-only

mx-keys-mini.keys: REPROG_CONTROLS_V4 0x1B04 temporary diversion of F4-F12 and Ins (cids 0xE2,0xE3,0x103,0x108,0x10A,0x11C,0xE5,0xE7,0xE8,0xE9), confirmed by getCidReporting; lost while the keyboard sleeps and renewed on WIRELESS_DEVICE_STATUS 0x1D4B wake-up; given back on exit; F4/F7 physically verified 2026-11-10
mx-keys-mini.fnKeys: FN_INVERSION 0x40A3 read only (byte 1 bit 0: 1 = printed functions first); diverted keys report the printed-function layer, so with Fn lock on they need Fn
mx-keys-mini.conflicts: Logi Options+ also receives presses of keys it diverts (F6-F12, Ins), so both actions run

g733.backend: HID++ 2.0 direct (046d:0afe usage ff43/0202, device index 0xFF)
g733.battery: ADC_MEASUREMENT 0x1F20 voltage, percent estimated with Solaar's curve (HeadsetControl 4.2 battery unreliable)
g733.lighting: COLOR_LED_EFFECTS 0x8070: zone 1 top and zone 0 bottom (same on both cups), static color (brightness by RGB scaling), Breathe 0x0A (period 6/4/2 s) and Cycle 0x03 (period 12/6/3 s), readback verified, not persistent; physically verified 2026-11-10
g733.buttons: GKEY 0x8010 software control: bit 0 microphone button, bit 1 short press of the power button; both switch together, holding power still turns the headset off; ends when the headset powers off and is renewed on the ADC power-on notification; physically verified 2026-11-10
g733.requires: Windows Dynamic Lighting off for this headset

aerox-3.lighting: front/middle/rear zones, hardware rainbow (no speed setting), app-animated breathing with speed, physically verified, no readback
aerox-3.dpiButton: button6 remapped to F23 for app actions, physically verified
aerox-3.persistence: not saved to onboard memory (lost when the mouse powers off)
